subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Rain cats and dogs
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Raining heavily**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Rain cats and dogs"** means to rain very heavily. It is a phrase used to describe a situation where there is a heavy downpour. (तेज़ बारिश होना)

 
 
• **Example:** We canceled our picnic plans as it was raining cats and dogs.
 
 
 
• **Raining heavily** refers to a situation where a large amount of rain falls in a short period, often accompanied by strong winds. (मूसलाधार बारिश)
 
 
• **Example:** The streets were flooded because it was raining heavily all night.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Doing something pointless** (अर्थहीन कार्य करना): Refers to engaging in an activity that has no meaningful result or purpose.

 
 
• **Example:** Arguing with someone who doesn’t listen is like doing something pointless.
 
 
 
• **Very rarely** (बहुत कम): Indicates something that happens infrequently or occasionally.
 
 
• **Example:** She visits her parents very rarely due to her busy schedule.
 
 
 
• **Do something unplanned** (बिना योजना के कुछ करना): Refers to taking actions spontaneously without prior planning.
 
 
• **Example:** We decided to do something unplanned and went on a road trip.
